correctness.rationale: The conditional independence calculation was reconstructed: given tags at separation d and their edge absent, each of n-2 iid background points avoids one tag with probability 1-m and avoids both with probability 1-2m+C(d); the exact covariance is b(d)^(n-2)-a^(2(n-2)), hence sign(C(d)-m²). The circle layer-cake convolution of centered arcs is strictly decreasing under continuous strictly decreasing radial H; mean over d equals m², so the crossing is unique. Poisson thinning yields exp(-2 lambda m)(exp(lambda C)-1), necessarily nonnegative. The hard-arc overlap C=max(2r-d,0)+max(2r+d-1,0) yields d*=2r(1-2r), the conditional positive fraction and maximum 3-2sqrt(2). Independently checked hard-radius exact rational grids, calculus maximum, and linear-soft antipodal covariance -1/12; finite checks are not the continuum proof.
